key.name: mode
key.description: The active power-button LED mode. Allowed values: "off", "white", "battery".

key.name: color-mode
key.description: The last selected colour mode ("white" or "battery"). Used to restore the previous choice when the LED is toggled back on.

key.name: threshold-white
key.description: Battery percentage at or above which the LED shows white in battery mode.

key.name: threshold-green
key.description: Battery percentage at or above which the LED shows green in battery mode (and below the white threshold).

key.name: threshold-yellow
key.description: Battery percentage at or above which the LED shows yellow in battery mode (and below the green threshold).

key.name: threshold-amber
key.description: Battery percentage at or above which the LED shows amber in battery mode (and below the yellow threshold). Below this value the LED shows red.

key.name: charge-indicator
key.description: When enabled, the LED shows blue while the battery is charging. Note: the blue LED component is non-functional on some Framework hardware.
